EVIDENCE PASSPORT

What we know.
What we don't.

KNOWN / METHODOLOGY

Dubai has published urban greening and climate resilience goals. LUNARIS provides a neighborhood investigation framework.

Dubai Municipality roadmap ↗
ASSUMED / SIMULATION

Tree number, canopy footprint, survival and corridor size are adjustable scenario inputs. Canopy footprints are simply summed and capped at 100%.

NOT VALIDATED / NEXT

No confirmed planting sites, field temperatures, planting permits, tree-species suitability, irrigation budgets or measured cooling outcomes.

03 / HEATSHIELD · WORKER PROTECTION CONCEPT

The people who build
our cities matter.

A language-aware heat-safety information prototype for outdoor construction workers and supervisors. Not a live occupational warning service.

Does not assess individual medical fitness or workplace heat exposure. Uses published time-based legislation only; certain narrowly defined activities have exceptions.

SAFETY INFORMATION / OFFICIAL POLICY

Select your work setting and time.

The UAE midday outdoor work restriction generally operates between 15 June and 15 September, 12:30–15:00.

Heat illness can occur outside legal break hours. Workers need employer-led risk assessment, breaks, hydration, shade and emergency arrangements.
Official UAE work guidance ↗Dubai heat-stress guidance ↗

Emergency in Dubai: Ambulance 998. This demo does not send voice, SMS or push alerts, determine nearby cooling centers, or calculate WBGT.

05 / CLIMESTATE · HOME RESILIENCE

Make your home
harder to harm.

A transparent self-assessment, with low-cost upgrade ideas. It does not diagnose flood risk from a photograph or certify building safety.

HOME ADAPTATION / SCREENING ONLY

Five questions. Clearer next steps.

  1. Answer the questions to generate a ranked list of areas to investigate.

The result reflects self-reported conditions only. It is not a structural inspection, engineering rating, flood forecast, or insurance eligibility decision. Electrical changes must be handled by qualified professionals.

06 / FOODPRINT · FOOD WASTE

Eat what you have.
Waste a little less.

A simple ingredient-first planner prioritizing foods by the expiry dates you enter. No camera recognition, donation matching or food-safety assurance.

Dates are user-supplied. Follow official storage guidelines; do not consume food merely because this tool suggests using it.

FRIDGE BRAIN / RULE-BASED MVP

What to use first

  1. Add your ingredients to see a time-based priority list.

Simple meal inspiration appears when recognizable ingredients are supplied.

Expiry date alone cannot establish safety. “Use by” dates and storage conditions must be respected.

Insurance literacy, not product matchmaking or a quote service. Availability and legal coverage depend on jurisdiction, policy wording and insurer.
